translations.title: Lo that pasa
translations.text:
¡happiness!… ¡happiness!… Dulzura
of the labio and peace of the soul… you he buscado
without tregua, eternamente, in the hermosura,
in the love and the arte… ¡and no you he hallado!


in vano, the soul, without cesar you nombra…
¡Oh light lejana, and por lejana, beautiful!…
¡Jamás the hand alcanzará the star!…
¿Pasaste over mí, as a shadow?


¿in brazos of what love has sido mía?..
¿no he besado your lips todavía?…
¿the shall I kiss, Señor?… over my oído


murmura alguna voice, remota and sad:
-Pasó por your garden… and no the viste…
¡and already, without conocerla, the has perdido!
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Balada
translations.text:
they knocked quedo, very quedo,

a the puertas of the house.

-¿Será algún dream- le dije-

that viene a alegrar your soul?


-¡Quizás! -contestó riendo…

his laughter and his voice soñaban.

Volvieron a llamar quedo

a the puertas of the house…


-¿Será the love?-grité, pálido,

llenos the eyes of tears…

-Acaso- said mirándome…

his voice of pasión temblaba…


they knocked quedo, very quedo,

a the puertas of the house.

-¿Será the death? -le dije…

Ella no me said nada…


and itself quedó inmóvil, rígida,

over the blanca almohada,

the hands as the cera

and the mejillas very pálidas.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Vorrei morire
translations.text:
Sentir intensamente the life. Haber amado
and haber sufrido mucho, tener the soul ciega
esperando in the shadow a light that no llega
or empeñada in dar life a a dream already pasado.


Amar lo fugitivo. Enamorarse of a
sonrisa, of a shadow… Sentir the poesía
of alguna melancólica and lejana armonía
that, of a balcón abierto, vuela bajo the moon.


Despreciar lo mezquino. Hacer with loco empeño
of the ensueño the life and of the life ensueño…
Extenuarse in a long caricia loca;


and al final of a afternoon magnífica and florida,
esfumarse in the sky, abandonar the life
with a sonorous verso of amores in the boca.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Nocturno of silver
translations.text:
Cruzas por my memories as a rayo of moon
that lo ilumina all of a blanca poesía…
the ruiseñor cantaba his love. Colgaba a
fina escala of seda from your celosía.


was the night a river cristalino and sonorous,
that arrastraba in his ondas, toward the eternity,
nuestro love as a carabela of gold,
palpitantes the velas bajo the tempestad.


among a deshojamiento of románticas roses
of light, juntos surcamos Venecias fabulosas,
in a olvido eterno of all… your laúd


desgranaba in the night his inmortal serenata…
¡and al pie of the marmórea and altiva escalinata
nos esperaba the paje of nuestra youth!
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Autorretrato
translations.text:
Por the espaciosa brow pálida and pensativa,

desciende the melena in dos rizos iguales.

Negros eyes miopes, gruesa nose lasciva,

the faz oval and fina, the lips sensuales.


over the flexible body, perturban the negrura

of the enlutado traje that his pain retrata,

the d’annunziano cuello with his nívea blancura

and with manchas sangrientas the flotante corbata.


Apura a cigarrillo Kedive, reclinado

in a diván oscuro, and among the humo azulado

of the tabaco, his eyes contemplan with love


the azul of the venas over the hands finas,

dignas of rasgar velos of princesas latinas

and ceñir the anillo of the Santo Pescador.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Ensueño of opio
translations.text:
is otra señorita of Maupin. is viciosa
and frágil as aquella imagen of the placer,
that in the elegancia rítmica of his sonorous prosa
nos dibujó the pluma of Theófilo Gautier.


his rojos lips sáficos, sensitivos and ambiguos,
a the par piden kisses of man and of woman,
sintiendo the nostalgias of the faunos antiguos
cuyos lips sabían alargar the placer.


Ama the goces sádicos. itself inyecta of morfina;
pincha a his gata blanca. the éter the fascina,
and the opio le produce a ensueño oriental.


of súbito his body of love vibra and itself inflama
al ver, among the juncos, temblar as a llama
the lengua roja and móvil of algún tigre real.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: of the afternoon of octubre bajo the light gloriosa...
translations.text:
of the afternoon of octubre bajo the light gloriosa,

in the fountain of mármol that the arrayán orilla,

diluyen the cipreses his esmeralda herrumbrosa

and the arcada of the fondo his tristeza amarilla.


Rosales and naranjos…Mustio the garden reposa

in a verdor that the gold of the autumn apolilla…

¡Sólo, a veces, itself enciende the llama of a rose,

or the gold polvoriento of a naranja brilla!


Mas, dentro of este autumn, there is tanta spring

in gérmenes; and is all tan sweet and apacible,

that antes of abandonarlo, my heart quisiera,

oyendo the melodioso to sigh of the fountain

and soñando with a Lindaraja imposible,

over este viejo banco dormir eternamente…
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: farewell a Cuba
translations.text:
with ternuras of mother and piedades of hermana

me ofreciste a oasis of peace in esta war,

por eso al alejarse the errante caravana,

your memory in the fondo of the heart encierra;


and with él the tristezas of his autumn engalana…

Pupila that the death without mirarte itself cierra

no sabrá what is belleza, because you eres, Habana,

the ciudad more beautiful that floreció in the earth.


¡in my farewell, as ofrenda, you dejo the soul mía!…

¡that the dioses you amparen, ciudad of encantamiento,

and that always contemple the pupila viajera


over the maravilloso cristal of your bahía

fulgurar ondulante a the gloria of the wind

the star solitaria that brilla in your bandera!…
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: I sé that the hope is viva, and that dentro
translations.text:
I sé that the hope is viva, and that dentro

of the heart his lámpara dulcemente ilumina;

¡mas already without entusiasmos and without fuerzas me encuentro

for arrancarle nuevos tesoros a the mina!…


in the garden, a veces, of my memories entro

and encanezco of angustia mirando tanta ruina…

¡Cipreses and naranjos marchitos, and in the centro

a fountain that never of Sollozar termina!…


I sé that Lindaraja with his kisses pudiera

dar a my autumn a nuevo frescor of spring…

Pero is tan remota, ¡and is tan long the sendero!…


¡and me encuentro tan pobre, tan sad and tan rendido,

that a buscarla of nuevo por the life, prefiero

soñar eternamente that jamás ha existido!…
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Ofelia
translations.text:
Turbia of shadow, the water of the remanso
reflejó nuestras trémulas imágenes,
extáticas of love, bajo the crepúsculo,
in the enferma esmeralda of the paisaje…


was the frágil olvido of the flowers
in the azul silencio of the afternoon,
a desfile of inquietas golondrinas
over pálidos cielos otoñales…


in a beso very long and very profundo
nos bebimos the tears of the aire,
and fueron nuestras vidas as a dream
and the minutos as eternidades…


Al despertar of the éxtasis, había
a peace funeraria in the paisaje,
estertores of fiebre in nuestras hands
and in nuestras bocas a sabor of blood…


and in the remanso turbio of tristeza
flotaba the dulzura of the afternoon,
enredada and sangrante among the juncos,
with the inconsciencia inmóvil of a cadáver.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: the Virgin cantaba...
translations.text:
the Virgin cantaba,

the dueña dormía…

the spindle giraba

loca of joy.


-¡Cordero divino,

your blancos vellones

no igualan al lino

of my ilusiones!


spin, spindle mía;

spin, spin al wind…

¡Amanece the day

of my casamiento!


¡Hila with cuidado

my velo of nieve,

that vendrá the Amado

that al altar me lleve!


itself acerca… Le siento

cruzar the llanura…

Sueña the ternura

of his voice the wind…


¡spin, spindle loca;

spin, spin, spin!

¡his labio suspira

por besar my boca!


¡spin, that tomorrow,

when the alba cante

the clara campana,

llegará my lover!


¡Cordero divino,

your blancos vellones

no igualan al lino

of my ilusiones!


the light itself apagaba;

the dueña dormía;

the Virgin hilaba,

and sólo itself oía


the voice crepitante

of the leña seca…,

and the loco and constante

girar of the spindle.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: the tears sonoras of a copla
translations.text:
the tears sonoras of a copla

with the perfume of the night entran

por my balcón, and all cuanto duerme

in my callado heart despierta.


«¡love, love, love! blood of celos»,

gime the sad copla callejera:

blanca dove wound that bleeding

a refugiarse a my memories llega.


¿already no recuerdas aquel face pálido,

the pupilas tan grandes and tan negras

that you hicieron odiar al love mismo

and maldecir the life and the belleza,

and amar the crimen and gustar the blood

that tibia mana of the wound fresca?


Duerme already, heart… itself va the music

aullando of pasión por the calleja.


and in the peace of the night sólo late

the time in the reloj that, lento, cuenta

the venturas perdidas for always

and the dolores that sufrir you quedan.


«¡love, love, love’. ¡that nadie bese

lo that ni in dreams my hope besa!

¡Antes that in brazos of otro love, prefiero

among my brazos contemplarte dead!
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Elegía of the youth
translations.text:
Sacar in hombros por my door
I looked ayer a ataúd,
where among flowers iba dead
   my youth.


Perdida all fuerza física
the vi in my brazos expirar.
as a pobre novia tísica
   ¡of tanto amar!


over his body, the postreras
roses of autumn deshojé.
and among memories and quimeras
   the amortajé.


for no ver his face amado
tendí a pañuelo por his faz.
and exclamé in tears bañado:
   -¡descansa in peace!


Lenta the lluvia descendía…
the golondrina iba a partir…
and until the brisa parecía
among the árboles gemir.


Cármenes viejos of Granada,
in a crepúsculo otoñal,
vieron perderse in the enramada
   his funeral.


Almas sedientas of ideales
that tanto amó my youth…
¡Deshojar roses otoñales
   in his ataúd!


and you, incansable peregrino.
that the world cruzas without cesar,
¡if ves his entierro in your path,
   ponte a rezar!


Sacar in hombros por my door
I looked ayer afternoon a ataúd,
where among flowers iba dead
   my youth.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: in earth lejana...
translations.text:
in earth lejana

I have I a hermana.


always in spring

my llegada espera

tras of the window.


and a the golondrina

that in his rejas trina

dice with dulzura:


-¡Por aquella espina

that arrancaste a Cristo,

dime if le has visto

cruzar the llanura!


¡the ave his queja

lanza temerosa,

and in the afternoon rose,

bajo the sun itself aleja!


from his window,

my pálida hermana

pregunta al traveler

that camina sad:


-¡Por your love primero,

dime if le viste

por ese sendero!


¡Pero the pasajero

his calvario sube,

and itself aleja lento,

dejando a nube

of polvo in the wind!


from his window

a the moon grita

my pálida hermana:


-¡Por the faz bendita

of the Crucificado,

dime in what sendero

your rayo postrero

his paso ha alumbrado!


¡the moon the vaga

llanura ilumina,

trémula declina,

and in the sea itself apaga!


Acaso I, errante,

pasé vacilante

baja your window,

and without conocerme,

my pálida hermana,

preguntes al verme

venir tan lejano:


-Dime, peregrino:

¿has visto a my hermano

por ese path?
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: ¿knows alguien the love?
translations.text:
¿knows alguien the love?

¡the love is a dream without fin!

is as a lánguido sopor

among the flowers of a garden…

¿knows alguien the love?


is a anhelo misterioso

that al labio hace to sigh,

torna al cobarde in valeroso

and al more valiente hace temblar;


is a perfume embriagador

that let pálida the faz;

is the palmera of the peace

in the desiertos of the pain…

¿knows alguien the love?


is a senda florecida,

is a licor that hace olvidar

all the glorias of the life,

menos the gloria of the amar…


is peace in medio of the war.

Fundirse in uno siendo dos…

¡the única dicha that in the earth

a the creyentes les da God!


Quedarse inmóvil and cerrar

the eyes for mejor ver;

and bajo a beso adormecer…,

and bajo a beso despertar…


is a fulgor that hace cegar.

¡is as a huerto all in flower

that nos convida a reposar!

¿knows alguien the love?

¡all conocen the love!


the love is as a garden

envenenado of pain…,

where the pain no has fin.

¡all conocen the love!


is as a áspid venenoso

that always sabe emponzoñar

al noble pecho generoso

where le quieran alentar.


Al more leal traidor,

is the ceguera of the abismo

and the ilusión of the espejismo…

in the desiertos of the pain.

¡all conocen the love!


¡is laberinto without salida

is a ola of pesar

that nos arroja of the life

as the náufragos of the sea!


Provocación of all war…,

sufrir in uno the of dos…

¡the mayor sorrow that in the earth

a the creyentes les da God!


is a perpetuo agonizar,

a alarido, a estertor,

that hace al more santo blasfemar…

¡all conocen the love!
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Partiendo of the light, where solía...
translations.text:
Partiendo of the light, where solía

		venir his light, my eyes me han cegado;
perdió también the heart
		cuitado
the precioso manjar of that lived.
the
		soul desechó the compañía
of the body, and fuese tras the face amado;

		así in my sad ausencia he always estado
ciego and with hambre and without
		the soul mía.

		Agora that al lugar, that the thought
never dejó, my pasos
		presurosos
después of mil trabajos me han traído,

		cobraron light my eyes tenebrosos
and his pastura the heart hambriento,

		pero no tornará the soul a his nido.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: A Celestina
translations.text:
Yace in esta earth cold,

worthy of all crianza,

the vieja cuya alabanza

tantas plumas merecía.


no quiso in the sky entrar

a gozar of the stars,

por no to be among doncellas

that no pudiese manchar.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: A a miserly
translations.text:
in aqueste burial

Humilde, pobre and mezquino,

Yace envuelto in gold fino

a man rich miserly.


Murió with cien mil dolores

without poderlo remediar,

Tan alone por no gastar

Ni aun gasta malos humores.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: lover without reposo
translations.text:
is the ave in the aire with sosiego,

in the water the pez, the salamandra in fire,

and the man, in cuyo to be all itself encierra,

is in the sola earth.

I alone, that nací for tormentos,

the boca I have in aire suspirando,

the body in earth is peregrinando,

the eyes I have in water night and day,

and in fire the heart and the soul mía.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Habiendo llamado a his zagala Aurora, pide a the of the sky that itself detenga
translations.text:
you, princesa bellísima of the day,

of the sombras nocturnas triunfadora,

gold risueño and púrpura pintora,

of the aire melancólico joy;


pues of the sun that you sigue and that you envía

eres flagrante and rica embajadora;

pues por ennoblecerte llamé Aurora

the beautiful without igual, zagala mía;


already that the night me privó of vella,

and esquiva my dos eyes, pïadosa

entretenme his imagen in his star.


Niégale al sun the horas, no invidiosa

his llama, that your luces atropella,
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: A a man of gran nose
translations.text:
Érase a man a a nose pegado,

érase a nose superlativa,

érase a nose sayón and escriba,

érase a peje sword very barbado.


was a reloj of sun mal encarado,

érase a alquitara pensativa,

érase a elefante boca arriba,

was Ovidio Nasón more narizado.


Érase a espolón of a galera,

érase a pirámide of Egipto,

the doce Tribus of narices was.


Érase a naricísimo infinito,

muchísimo nose, nose tan fiera

that in the cara of Anás fuera delito.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Disparado esmeril, bull wounded...
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: for comprar the hados more propicios
translations.text:
for comprar the hados more propicios,
as if the deidad vendible fuera,
with the bull mejor of the ribera
ofreces cautelosos sacrificios.


Pides felicidades a your vicios;
for your nave rica and usurera,
wind tasado, and onda lisonjera,
mereciéndole al golfo precipicios.


because exceda a the cuenta your tesoro,
a your ambición, no a Júpiter engañas,
that él cargó the montañas over the gold.


and when l’ara in blood humosa bañas,
you miras the entrañas of your bull,
and God is mirando your entrañas.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: ¿Castigas in the eagle the delito?
translations.text:
¿Castigas in the eagle the delito

of the celos of Juno vengadora,

because in velocidad alta and sonorous

llevó a Jove robado the catamito?


¿or juzgaste his osar por infinito

in atrever his eyes a your aurora,

confiada in the vista vencedora,

with that miran al sun of hito in hito?


¿or because sepa Jove that in the sky,

when Venus fulminas, of your rayo

ni the suyo is seguro, ni his vuelo?


¿or a César amenazas with desmayo,

derramando his emblema por the suelo,

honrando the leones of Pelayo?
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Arrepentimiento and tears debidas al deception of the life
translations.text:
flee without percibirse lento the day,

and the hora secreta and recatada

with silencio itself acerca, and despreciada,

carries tras sí the edad lozana mía.


the life nueva that in niñez ardía,

the youth robusta and engañada,

in the postrer winter sepultada

Yace among negra shadow and nieve cold.


no sentí resbalar mudos the años;

Hoy the lloro pasados, and the I see

Riendo of my tears and daños.


my penitencia deba a my desire,

Pues me deben the life my engaños,

and espero the mal that paso and no le creo.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: knows the diligencia with that itself acerca the death
translations.text:
already formidable and espantoso suena

dentro of the heart the postrer day,

and the última hora, negra and cold,

itself acerca, of fear and sombras llena.


if agradable descanso, peace serena,

the death in traje of pain envía,

señas da his desdén of cortesía:

more has of caricia that of sorrow.


¿what pretende the fear desacordado

of the that a rescatar, piadosa, viene

espíritu in miserias añudado?


Llegué rogada, pues my bien previene;

hallame agradecido, no asustado;

my life acabe and my to live ordene.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: Desengaño of the mujeres
translations.text:
Puto is the man that of putas fía,

and puto the that his gustos apetece;

puto is the estipendio that itself ofrece

in pago of his puta compañía.


Puto is the gusto, and puta the joy

that the rato putaril nos encarece;

and I diré that is puto a quien parece

that no sois puta vos, señora mía.


Mas llámenme a mí puto enamorado,

if al cabo for puta no os dejare;

and as puto muera I quemado


if of otras tales putas me pagare,

because the putas graves are costosas,

and the putillas viles, afrentosas.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: lover that hace lección for aprender a amar of maestros irracionales
translations.text:
musical weeping in tears sonoras

llora mountain doblado in cueva cold,

and destilando líquida armonía,

hace the peñas cítaras canoras.


Ameno and escondido a all horas,

in mucha shadow alberga poco day:

no admite his silencio compañía,

sólo a ti, solitario, when lloras.


are your nombre, color, and voice doliente,

señas more that of pájaro, of lover:

puede aprender pain of ti a ausente.


Estudia in your lamento and your semblante

gemidos este mountain and esta brow:

and tienes my pain por estudiante.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: in the claustros of the soul the wound
translations.text:
in the claustros of the soul the wound
yace callada; mas consume hambrienta
the life, that in my venas alimenta
llama the medulas extendida.


Bebe the ardor hidrópica my life,
that already ceniza lover and macilenta,
cadáver of the incendio beautiful, ostenta
his light in humo and night fallecida.


the gente esquivo, and me is horror the day;
dilato in largas voces black weeping,
that a sordo sea my ardiente sorrow envía.


A the suspiros di the voice of the song,
the confusión inunda l’soul mía:
my heart is reino of the espanto.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: if the abismo, in diluvios desatado
translations.text:
if the abismo, in diluvios desatado
hubiera all the fire consumido;
the that enjuga my venas, mantenido
of my blood, le hubiera restaurado.


if the day, por Faetón descaminado,
hubiera all the sea and aguas bebido,
with the piadoso weeping that he vertido,
the hubieran my eyes renovado.


if the legiones all of the vientos
guardar Ulises in prisión pudiera,
my suspiros without fin otros formaran.


if of the infierno all the tormentos,
with his music Orfeo suspendiera,
otros my sorrows nuevos inventaran.
translations.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.

translations.title: love me ocupa the seso and the sentidos
translations.text:
love me ocupa the seso and the sentidos:
absorto estoy in éxtasi amoroso,
no me concede tregua ni reposo
esta war civil of the nacidos.


Explayose the raudal of my gemidos
por the great distrito, and doloroso
of the heart, in his penar dichoso,
and my memorias anegó in olvidos;


all soy ruinas, all soy destrozos,
escándalo funesto a the amantes,
that fabrican of lástima his gozos.


the that han of to be and the that fueron antes,
estudien his salud in my sollozos,
and envidien my pain, if are constantes.

translations.title: A Lísida pidiéndole unas flowers that had in the hand
translations.text:
already that huyes of mí, Lísida beautiful,

imita the costumbres of esta fountain,

that flee of the orilla eternamente,

and always the fecunda generosa.


flee of mí cortés and desdeñosa,

sígate of my eyes the corriente,

and, aunque of paso, tanto fire ardiente

merézcate a hierba and a rose.


Pues my sorrow ocasionas, pues you ríes

of the congojoso weeping that derramo

in sacrificio al claustro of rubíes,


perdona lo that soy por lo that amo,

and when desdeñosa you desvíes,

llévate allá the voice with that you llamo.

translations.title: in brief cárcel traigo aprisionado
translations.text:
in brief cárcel traigo aprisionado,
with all his familia of gold ardiente,
the cerco of the light resplandeciente,
and great imperio of the love cerrado.


Traigo the campo that pacen estrellado
the fieras altas of the piel luciente,
and a escondidas of the sky and of the Oriente,
day of light and parto mejorado.


Traigo all the Indias in my hand,
perlas that in a diamante por rubíes
pronuncian with desdén sonorous hielo;


and razonan tal vez fire tirano,
relámpagos of laughter carmesíes,
auroras, gala and presunción of the sky.

translations.title: to live is to walk brief jornada
translations.text:
to live is to walk brief jornada,
and death viva is, Lico, nuestra life,
ayer al frágil body amanecida,
cada instante in the body sepultada.


Nada, that siendo, is poco, and será nada
in poco time, that ambiciosa olvida;
pues of the vanidad mal persuadida,
anhela duración, earth animada.


Llevada of engañoso thought,
and of hope burladora and ciega,
tropezará in the mismo monumento.


as the that divertido the sea navega,
and without moverse vuela with the wind,
and antes that piense in acercarse, llega.

translations.title: A a rose
translations.text:
Yesterday you were born, and you will die tomorrow.

for tan brief to be, ¿who you dio life?

¿for to live tan poco estás lucida,

and for no to be nada estás lozana?


if you engañó his hermosura vana,

bien presto the verás desvanecida,

because in your hermosura is escondida

the ocasión of morir death temprana.


when you corte the robusta hand,

ley of the agricultura permitida,

grosero aliento acabará your suerte.


no salgas, that you wait algún tirano;

dilata your nacer for your life,

that anticipas your to be for your death.

translations.title: wait, riguroso thought
translations.text:
wait, riguroso thought,

no pierdas the respect a cuyo eres.

Imagen, sun or shadow, ¿what me quieres?

Déjame sosegar in my aposento.


Divina Tirsis, abrasarme siento:

sé blanda as beautiful among mujeres;

look that ausente, as estás, me hieres;

afloja already the cuerdas al tormento.


Hablándote a mí solas me anochece:

contigo anda cansada the soul mía;

contigo reasoning me amanece.


you the night me ocupas and you the day:

without ti all me aflige and entristece,

and in ti my mismo mal me da joy.

translations.title: A Flori, that had unos carnations among the hair blond
translations.text:
Al gold of your brow unos carnations

I see matizar, cruentos, with heridas;

ellos mueren of love, and a nuestras vidas

his amenazas les avisan faithful.


Rúbricas are piadosas, and crueles,

joyas facinorosas, and advertidas,

pues publicando muertes florecidas,

ensangrientan al sun rizos doseles.


Mas with your lips quedan vergonzosos

(that no compiten flowers a rubíes)

and pálidos después, of temerosos.


and when with relámpagos you ríes

of púrpura, cobardes, if ambiciosos,

marchitan his blasones carmesíes.
